hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.lua) stylua "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.lua) output=$(luacheck "$f" --no-color 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"luacheck warnings:\n%s"}}' "$output"; fi ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
